tei:div.tei:p: (79)bla sgrub ye shes drwa ba bzhugs so/ (80)

na mo gu ru bhya/ bkod pa chen po las/ gang zhig lha sku 'bul phrag bsgom pa bas/ bla ma'i sku la dmigs pa ma yengs na/ bsod nams brgya phrag stong ni char mi bod/ bsnyen bsgrub bzlas brjod pa ya dung phyur bas/ bla ma'i gsol 'debs lan gsum brjod pa yi/ nus pa 'bum phrag char yang mi phod do/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa bskal pa'i bar du yang*/ gang gis 'di 'ji spangs nas bsgoms pa bas/ bla ma rang sems dkyil du shar ba tsam/ bsod nas stong phrag nye ba'i char mi bod/ zhes pa bzhin du bla ma sgrub pa'i rim pa ni/ oṃ/ rlung lnga rnam dag dwangs ma'i dbyings/ sku gsum mjad pa mthar phyin gzhi/ sems nyid don gyi bla ma la/ rang bzhin rtogs pas skyabs su mchi/ ma rig 'jin rten mun pa'i klong*/ gzung 'jin 'khrul bas 'khyams pa rnams/ (81)thabs shes rang rig sgron me 'dis/ chos nyid dbyings la gsal bar bgyi/ ho/ rdo rje'i bla ma'i dam tshig tu/ sems can kun la byams sems bsgoms/ rin chen ba ma'i dam tshig tu/ chags zhen mi bya sbyin pa gtong*/ padma bla ma'i dam tshig tu/ bud med mi spangs bde stong bsgoms/ las kyi bla ma'i dam tshig tu/ shugs 'byung rang dag spyod pa skyong*/ thabs shes zung 'jug ngang nyid dngos/ gang shar chos nyid rol pa las/ thugs 'phrad shugs 'byung tshogs chen rdzogs/ āḥ sems nyid stong gsal 'gyur ba med/ snying po rang grol 'chi med skyong*/ spyod pa tshogs drug lhug par zhog 'bras bu re dogs zhig pa'i lha/ mu bzhi'i mtha' bral bla ma ni/ sku lnga dang ni ye shes lnga/ (82)rigs lnga 'od lnga rlung ni lnga/ shes rab lnga la sogs par gnas/ rang rig rang rtsal sku lnga shar/ rnam dag dbyings kyi zhing khams su/ thig le stong pa'i gzhal yas nas/ kun bzang bla ma bī ma la/ gsal zhing phra la brtags dka' ba/ ye shes rnam pa thams cad pa/ 'od gsal chen po snang ba'i sku/ 'pho 'gyur med pa rdo rje'i sku/

'od gsal 'phel ba rin chen 'byung*/ stong gsal snang ba mtha' yas gsung*/ 'od lnga lhun grub don yod grub/ chos nyid mngon sum mkha' la shar/ gang 'phel rig pa'i la shan 'byed/ rig pa tshad phebs gdos bcas bral/ chos zad 'bras bu mthar phyin dbyings/ snang dang mi snang 'jin pa bral/ ngo bo nyid med chos nyid gshis/ nyams lus dbang po rtog tshogs dang*/ tshig dang 'khrul zad dwangs ma'i sku/ dmar gsalal mtshong (83)ltar dag pa'i nyams/ zhi 'jum paṇḍi ta yi chas/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams/ 'od kyi klong na lham mer gsal/ zhing khams thams cad sku la rdzogs/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi 'jin pa bral/ bri ba med cing 'phel ba med/ rang grol chos sku chos zad mtha'/ sku dang ye shes 'gags pa med/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul rtsal gyi chos/ stobs dang mi 'jigs ye nas rdzogs/ zag pa rang zad chen por gsal/ lnga ldan bcu ldan brgya ldan dang*/ tshom bu stong dang 'bum phrag ni/ rang bzhin dag pa chen po yis/ brjod kyi mi lang grangs med 'char/ hūm̐/ bzhugs pa'i stangs ni rnam pa gsum/ ye shes rdo rje lcags kyu che/ gzigs pa'i tshul ni rmad byung ba/ 'jin pa chen po (84)zhags pa che/ dbyangs dang rig pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ rdo rje'i lcags sgrogs rdzogs pa las/ rlung dang rig gnad dril bu yis/ 'gyu 'phro rtogs pa yan mi 'gyur/ ye nas gzhi rdzogs phyag rgya bzhi'i/ snang bzhi mthar phyin don gyi lha/ rig 'jin bla ma sprul 'khor bcas/ mngaun sum dbyings nas spyan drang ngo*/ shes rab rang byung sgron ma dang*/ dbyer med chu la chu la bzhag bzhin/ 'du 'bral med pa rdzogs la 'dud/ dbyings kyi snang ba rin po che/ 'od dang drwa phyed phu gu'i phreng*/ mchod rten rdo rje 'khor lo dang*/ ral gri drwa ba rgya gram dang*/ mig mang ris dang mig tshag dang*/ mda' dang padma nyi zla dang*/ ye shes mkhar thabs me lce ris/ rig pa'i 'char tshul ma 'gags pa 'dra min snang dpyad ngang*/

stong gsum sgron ma thig le'i sku/ rgyan (85)dang gzhal yas yongs rdzogs pa/ lnga ldan rgyan gyis spras pa'i tshogs/ 'phrul dga'i lha yi longs spyod bzhin/ gnyis med mnyam pa chen por bzhes/ gsal dang gsal byed rig pas khyab/ gsung ni rang byung rang snang ba/ spro bsdu snang ba'i 'khor lo ni/ thugs kyi rgyun chad med gzigs pa/ mkhyen pa'i rtsal dang dgongs pa'o/ yon tan chen po rdzogs pa la/ dgongs gsal mngon shes lhun gyis grub/ phrin las chos kyi 'khor lo las/ phyi nang gsang ba rnams spros te/ sems dpa'i rigs kyi sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang*/ rang byung ljags las rnams spros te/ 'khor lo rang gi ngo bos ston/ grol sa thog ma gang la 'dud/ rig pa rdo rje (86)lu gu rgyud/ mthong ba tsam gyis shes pa dang*/ shes pa tsam gyis grol ba dang*/ mngon rdzogs gnad 'di sus mthong ba/ khams gsum ldog pa ma yin no/ bla ma'i thugs mchong gur phub pa lta bu'i klong du dbyings rnam dag gi thig le mthing ka'i dbus su shes rab rang byung gi sgron me hūm̐ yig spus bris pa lta bu'i mthar rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rang bzhin du 'phros pas phyi nang snod bcud thams cad bla ma'i rol pa rigs lnga'i zhing khams dang gzhal yas khang dang lha dang lha mo'i rol par lta ste/ oṃ ma hā gu ru sha ri raṃ ghi li hūm̐/ zhes bzla zhing dgongs pa chos nyid kyi rang mdangs bskyangs ngo*/ kun gyi rgyal po chos nyid srog sangs rgyas (87((88)kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus/ mi 'gyur gsang ba'i sngags chen po/ gsang sngags 'bru gcig āḥnyid bzlas/ de nas lta stangs gzigs stangs gcun/ ka dag lhun grub 'od gsal bsgom/ bying rgod gral bar brtson byas te/ rjes la sems can don la bsngo bar 'ga' mi rtag 'chi ba sgom/ chos rnams sgyu ma rmi lam bsgom/

bar do'i gdams par dran par bya'o/ de ltar bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la/ brgyud gsum bla ma'i byin gyis rlobs/ yi dam dngos grub char bzhin 'bebs/ ma dang mkha' 'gros srung zhing skyobs/ gnas skabs las bzhi'i dngos grub dang*/ 'od gsal go 'phang mchog la sbyor/ mthar thug mngon par sangs rgyas 'grub/ yid ches rgyal ba'ilus la dris/ zhes mos slob mgon rten ngor chos smra ba'i btsun pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos zla yul grwa lag gsang sngags pho brang rtser sbyar ba dge'o/// /
